stem: During the 1920s, what was one result of innovations in U.S. transportation technology?

options.label: F
options.text: Commercial airplanes replaced ocean liners as the primary means of travel to Europe.

options.label: G
options.text: Mass-produced automobiles made travel more affordable for many people.

options.label: H
options.text: Cable cars provided a comfortable means of quick travel to any city within a state.

options.label: J
options.text: Container ships delivered agricultural goods to ports along the Pacific coast.
